letter-a.label: A
letter-a.hint: Point to the thumb tip of your passive hand (vowels run thumb → little finger).

letter-b.label: B
letter-b.hint: Both hands make a ring with thumb and index; the rings touch side by side.

letter-c.label: C
letter-c.hint: One hand only: curve thumb and index into a C.

letter-d.label: D
letter-d.hint: Curved thumb and index of the dominant hand against the upright index of the other hand, making a D.

letter-e.label: E
letter-e.hint: Point to the tip of the index finger.

letter-f.label: F
letter-f.hint: Two fingers laid across two fingers.

letter-h.label: H
letter-h.hint: Flat palm brushes across the other palm.

letter-i.label: I
letter-i.hint: Point to the tip of the middle finger.

letter-j.label: J
letter-j.hint: Start like I (middle fingertip), then draw a little hook down. Watch it at 0.5×.

letter-k.label: K
letter-k.hint: Dominant index curls over the top of the other hand's upright index finger.

letter-l.label: L
letter-l.hint: Index finger laid flat across the palm.

letter-m.label: M
letter-m.hint: Three fingers laid on the palm.

letter-n.label: N
letter-n.hint: Two fingers laid on the palm.

letter-o.label: O
letter-o.hint: Point to the tip of the ring finger.

letter-p.label: P
letter-p.hint: A thumb-and-index ring held at the tip of the other index finger.

letter-q.label: Q
letter-q.hint: The dominant hand hooks onto the other hand, like the tail of a Q. Watch it at 0.5×.

letter-r.label: R
letter-r.hint: Bent (crooked) index finger resting on the palm.

letter-t.label: T
letter-t.hint: Index fingertip touches the little-finger edge of the upright passive hand.

letter-u.label: U
letter-u.hint: Point to the tip of the little finger.

letter-v.label: V
letter-v.hint: V-shape (index + middle) pressed onto the palm.

letter-y.label: Y
letter-y.hint: Index finger laid into the web between thumb and index of the other hand.

letter-z.label: Z
letter-z.hint: Flat hand, palm down, against the heel of the other upright palm.

again.label: AGAIN
again.hint: Two-finger (V) hand flicks up. Also used as 'Pardon?'

age.label: AGE / HOW-OLD
age.hint: Hand in front of the nose, closing as it moves down. With raised eyebrows: 'How old?'

all.label: ALL
all.hint: Flat hand, palm down, sweeps around in a circle.

also.label: ALSO
also.hint: Dominant hand touches the second finger of the other hand, like listing a second item.

angry.label: ANGRY
angry.hint: Hand flicks out to the side with an angry face.

aunt.label: AUNT
aunt.hint: Two thumbs-up hands meet in front of the chest. Watch at 0.5×.

auslan.label: AUSLAN
auslan.hint: Both open hands, one at chest height and one up near the shoulder; the fingers flick and flutter.

baby.label: BABY
baby.hint: Arms cradle and rock a baby.

beard.label: BEARD
beard.hint: Both hands stroke down from the cheeks to the chin.

birthday.label: BIRTHDAY
birthday.hint: Five regional versions! Southern: both hands raised, palms out, shaking. WA: from the mouth, then the index points forward.

blue.label: BLUE
blue.hint: Southern: flat hand strokes the back of the other hand. Northern: two fingers rub the back of the hand.

bored.label: BORED
bored.hint: Thumb-and-finger ring at the chin flicks out; bored face.

both.label: BOTH
both.hint: Two-finger (V) hand moves between the two people.

brother.label: BROTHER
brother.hint: Two fists side by side rub against each other.

brown.label: BROWN
brown.hint: Southern: fingers at the mouth. Northern: flat hand circles on the back of the other hand.

buy.label: BUY
buy.hint: Hand moves forward off the other palm, as if paying.

bye.label: BYE
bye.hint: Hand up beside the shoulder, fingers bend down and up together: a wave.

cat.label: CAT
cat.hint: Thumb and index pinch at the cheek and pull out: whiskers.

child.label: CHILD
child.hint: Flat hand, palm down, pats at a child's height.

colour.label: COLOUR
colour.hint: Fingers rub against the other hand (Australia-wide); index rubs the back of the hand (SA).

cousin.label: COUSIN
cousin.hint: Hand at the cheek with a small shaking movement. Watch at 0.5×.

daughter.label: DAUGHTER
daughter.hint: A short two-handed sign in front of the chest. Watch at 0.5×.

deaf.label: DEAF
deaf.hint: Index finger touches the ear, then the mouth.

dog.label: DOG
dog.hint: Both hands bent like paws in front of the chest: a begging dog.

dollar.label: DOLLAR
dollar.hint: Fingers brush across the upturned palm.

dont-know.label: DON'T-KNOW
dont-know.hint: Both hands out to the sides, palms up, with a shrug and a down-turned mouth.

eight.label: EIGHT
eight.hint: Thumb plus two fingers, pointing sideways.

eighteen.label: EIGHTEEN
eighteen.hint: EIGHT handshape with an added movement.

eleven.label: ELEVEN
eleven.hint: Index-finger movement near the face (Australia-wide) or a flicking index (Southern). Watch at 0.5×.

everyone.label: EVERYONE
everyone.hint: Both index fingers up, sweeping round to everyone. Watch at 0.5×.

excited.label: EXCITED
excited.hint: Both hands brush up the chest alternately; bright face.

excuse-me.label: EXCUSE-ME
excuse-me.hint: Fingertips of one hand brush across the other palm.

family.label: FAMILY
family.hint: Both hands circle out and come together: a group.

feel.label: FEEL
feel.hint: Bent middle finger brushes up the chest.

fifteen.label: FIFTEEN
fifteen.hint: FIVE handshape with an added movement.

fingerspell.label: FINGERSPELL
fingerspell.hint: Both hands, fingers fluttering in front of the body, as if spelling.

four.label: FOUR
four.hint: Four fingers up, thumb tucked in.

fourteen.label: FOURTEEN
fourteen.hint: FOUR handshape with an added movement.

friend.label: FRIEND
friend.hint: Hands clasped together in front of the body.

from.label: FROM
from.hint: Hand moves away from a starting point, as in 'come from'. Watch at 0.5×.

glasses.label: GLASSES
glasses.hint: Hand traces from beside the eye back to the ear, like the arm of a pair of glasses.

good-morning.label: GOOD MORNING
good-morning.hint: Thumbs-up (GOOD) hand at the upper chest. The Northern and Southern versions differ slightly, so compare them at 0.25×.

grandfather.label: GRANDFATHER
grandfather.hint: Starts with a movement, then the F of FATHER. Compare with FATHER.

grandmother.label: GRANDMOTHER
grandmother.hint: Australia-wide: a two-handed sign in front of the chest. Southern: starts at the nose. Watch at 0.5×.

green.label: GREEN
green.hint: Australia-wide: flat hand brushes along the other forearm. Northern: hand at the temple.

grey.label: GREY
grey.hint: Australia-wide: flat hand on the cheek (compare with Southern PURPLE!). SA: palms brush past each other.

hair.label: HAIR
hair.hint: Pinch a bit of hair at the side of your head.

happy.label: HAPPY
happy.hint: Flat hand brushes up the other palm repeatedly, with a smile.

have.label: HAVE
have.hint: Open hand closes into a fist, as if grasping.

he-she.label: HE / SHE / IT
he-she.hint: Point to where the person is, or to the spot you've set up for them.

hearing.label: HEARING
hearing.hint: Upright index finger beside the ear, small repeated movement.

hello.label: HELLO
hello.hint: Flat hand starts beside the forehead and moves out and away, like a relaxed salute.

how.label: HOW
how.hint: Southern: the backs of bent fingers roll against each other. Northern: hands open out, palms up.

how-are-you.label: GOOD / HOW ARE YOU?
how-are-you.hint: Thumbs-up in front of the chest. With raised eyebrows it asks 'How are you?'; with a nod it answers 'Good!'

how-many.label: HOW-MANY
how-many.hint: Open hand, fingers fluttering as if counting; eyebrows down.

how-much.label: HOW-MUCH / COST
how-much.hint: Fingers flutter in front of the chin; eyebrows down.

hundred.label: HUNDRED
hundred.hint: Signbank's video here is temporary. Watch it at 0.5×.

know.label: KNOW
know.hint: Thumb touches the side of the forehead.

learn.label: LEARN
learn.hint: Hand on the forehead, fingers draw together as it pulls away, as if taking knowledge in.

live.label: LIVE
live.hint: Australia-wide: thumbs-up hand moves down the chest. Tasmania: both open hands at the chest.

love.label: LOVE
love.hint: Arms crossed over the chest: a hug.

married.label: MARRIED
married.hint: One hand comes down onto the back of the other hand.

maybe.label: MAYBE
maybe.hint: Thumbs-up hand rocks from side to side.

me.label: ME
me.hint: Index finger points to the middle of your own chest.

meet.label: MEET
meet.hint: Both hands come in from the sides and meet in front of the chest.

money.label: MONEY
money.hint: Thumb rubs across the fingertips: the 'money' gesture.

mother.label: MOTHER
mother.hint: The letter M (three fingers) tapped on the palm.

my.label: MY
my.hint: Closed fist placed against your chest.

name.label: NAME
name.hint: Index and middle fingers together touch the forehead, then move out to the side.

nice.label: NICE
nice.hint: Hand slides off the chin and finishes as a thumbs-up.

nine.label: NINE
nine.hint: Thumb plus three fingers, pointing sideways.

nineteen.label: NINETEEN
nineteen.hint: NINE handshape with an added movement.

no.label: NO
no.hint: Fingers snap shut onto the thumb; shake your head.

number.label: NUMBER
number.hint: Bunched fingertips at the mouth with a small movement.

okay.label: OKAY
okay.hint: Open hand with a small side-to-side wobble: 'fine, okay'.

old.label: OLD
old.hint: Hand at the nose and chin closes as it moves down. Very similar to AGE.

orange.label: ORANGE
orange.hint: Hand squeezes open and closed in front of the mouth, like squeezing an orange.

our.label: OUR
our.hint: MY-style fist moves in an arc across the chest.

parents.label: PARENTS
parents.hint: Starts at the forehead, then the fingers tap the other hand (MOTHER/FATHER style).

phone.label: PHONE
phone.hint: Thumb and little finger out (an old handset) held to the ear.

pink.label: PINK
pink.hint: Index finger brushing the lips (Southern), or the chin (Northern). Watch at 0.5×.

please.label: PLEASE
please.hint: Southern: open hand moves out from the chest. Northern: flat hand from the mouth ends as a thumbs-up.

purple.label: PURPLE
purple.hint: Southern: flat hand on the cheek. WA: hand at the chin, fingers moving. Northern: index fingers rub together.

question.label: QUESTION / ASK
question.hint: Index finger moves against the raised fingers of the other hand. Watch at 0.5×.

red.label: RED
red.hint: Southern: index finger on the lips. Northern: hand brushes down from the chin.

sad.label: SAD
sad.hint: Index finger drawn down from the mouth, with a sad face.

same.label: SAME
same.hint: Hand moves back and forth between you and the other person: 'me too, same'.

scared.label: SCARED
scared.hint: Flat hand on the chest; frightened face.

see-you-again.label: SEE YOU AGAIN
see-you-again.english: see you later, see you again
see-you-again.hint: V-hand moves out from beside the eye, then the index points at the other person.

seven.label: SEVEN
seven.hint: Thumb plus index finger, index pointing sideways.

seventeen.label: SEVENTEEN
seventeen.hint: SEVEN handshape with an added movement.

short.label: SHORT
short.hint: Flat hand moves down to a low height, palm down.

sick.label: SICK
sick.hint: Touch the forehead, then the hands come together in front of the body.

sign.label: SIGN
sign.hint: Bent hands circle alternately in front of the chest.

sister.label: SISTER
sister.hint: Bent index finger rubs the side of the nose.

six.label: SIX
six.hint: Just the thumb, pointing up. (6–9 are built on the thumb.)

sixteen.label: SIXTEEN
sixteen.hint: SIX (thumb) handshape with an added movement.

slow.label: SLOW
slow.hint: One hand strokes slowly up the back of the other hand.

sorry.label: SORRY
sorry.hint: Australia-wide: curved hand at the chin with a small movement and a sorry face.

spouse.label: HUSBAND / WIFE
spouse.hint: Touch the ring finger of the other hand, where a wedding ring goes.

tall.label: TALL
tall.hint: Flat hand raised high, palm down: showing someone's height.

ten.label: TEN
ten.hint: Closed hand springs open. Watch at 0.5×.

thank-you.label: THANK YOU
thank-you.hint: Flat hand from the chin moves forward and down towards the other person.

their.label: THEIR
their.hint: YOUR-style fist aimed at, and sweeping across, their location.

they.label: THEY
they.hint: Index sweeps across the places where those people are.

thirteen.label: THIRTEEN
thirteen.hint: THREE handshape with an added movement.

thousand.label: THOUSAND
thousand.hint: Index up (ONE), then the hand drops open. Watch at 0.5×.

three.label: THREE
three.hint: Index, middle and ring fingers up.

tired.label: TIRED
tired.hint: Bent hand at the chest drops down; tired face, slumped shoulders.

twelve.label: TWELVE
twelve.hint: Two-finger hand with a flicking movement. The Southern form also means 'dozen'. Watch at 0.5×.

uncle.label: UNCLE
uncle.hint: Both hands at the chest, fingertips meeting. Watch at 0.5×.

understand.label: UNDERSTAND
understand.hint: Index finger at the temple flicks up and away, like an idea landing.

very.label: VERY
very.hint: Australia-wide: both hands with a strong, tense movement. Southern: from the chin. Puff your cheeks for emphasis.

wait.label: WAIT / HOLD-ON
wait.hint: Index finger held up: 'hang on a moment'.

we.label: WE / US
we.hint: Index sweeps around to include you and the people with you.

what.label: WHAT
what.hint: Index finger up, small side-to-side shake, eyebrows down.

when.label: WHEN
when.hint: Fingers against the cheek, fluttering as if counting; eyebrows down.

where.label: WHERE
where.hint: Both hands palm-up, moving out to the sides; eyebrows down.

which.label: WHICH
which.hint: Thumb and little finger out, rocking side to side between choices.

white.label: WHITE
white.hint: Australia-wide: fingers flick near the face. WA: from the chin, then the index flicks up. Northern: index at the chest.

who.label: WHO
who.hint: Upright index finger with a small movement; eyebrows down.

why.label: WHY
why.hint: Flat hand, palm down; the fingers bend down. Eyebrows down.

worried.label: WORRIED
worried.hint: Hand at the side of the forehead with a small, repeated movement; worried face.

year.label: YEAR
year.hint: Index circles around the other hand: one trip around the sun.

yellow.label: YELLOW
yellow.hint: Southern: thumb-and-finger ring at the temple. Northern: index points and flicks at the temple.

yes.label: YES
yes.hint: A nodding hand (see the video), and nod your head too.

you.label: YOU
you.hint: Index finger points at the person you're talking to.

young.label: YOUNG
young.hint: Bent index finger brushes near the mouth/nose. Watch at 0.5×.

your.label: YOUR
your.hint: Closed fist pushed towards the other person.

zero.label: ZERO
zero.hint: Thumb and fingertips meet in an O shape, held up beside the shoulder.
